note: Conformance cases for docs/PLAN-FORMAT.md. A conforming validator must accept every case with "valid": true and reject every case with "valid": false, naming each key in invalid_keys. "expect" is a substring this project's own check must emit; it is a producer-side regression check, not a requirement on another implementation's wording.

cases.name: minimal-valid
cases.covers: plan_version is the only required key, so a plan that decides nothing is valid

cases.name: partial-valid
cases.covers: keys may be present one at a time; a partial plan stays valid

cases.name: full-valid
cases.covers: all nine keys, with the pages satisfying url_rules.max_depth

pages.purpose: what the store sells and how buying works
one product, its price and its availability

cases.name: open-vocabulary-valid
cases.covers: Schema.org types and properties outside any catalogue are carried, not rejected

cases.name: max-depth-boundary-valid
cases.covers: a page at exactly max_depth is within the rule

cases.name: host-name-case-valid
cases.covers: host names are case-insensitive, so upper case is accepted

cases.name: host-name-root-dot-valid
cases.covers: the root form of a domain is accepted

cases.name: not-an-object
cases.covers: the top level must be a JSON object

cases.name: missing-plan-version
cases.covers: the one required key

cases.name: unknown-version
cases.covers: a consumer refuses a version it does not implement

cases.name: version-not-an-integer
cases.covers: plan_version is an integer, not a string that looks like one

cases.name: unknown-top-level-key
cases.covers: unknown keys are invalid at every level

cases.name: unknown-kind
cases.covers: kind is a closed vocabulary

cases.name: unknown-surface
cases.covers: required_surfaces is a closed vocabulary

cases.name: surface-name-case
cases.covers: closed vocabulary values match exactly, including case

cases.name: duplicate-surface
cases.covers: a surface may be required once

cases.name: empty-surface-list
cases.covers: an empty list requires nothing, so the key is omitted instead

cases.name: identity-not-an-object
cases.covers: identity and offering are objects

cases.name: identity-empty-object
cases.covers: an object with neither schema_types nor fields says nothing

cases.name: identity-unknown-key
cases.covers: the nested keys are schema_types and fields, exactly

cases.name: offering-empty-fields
cases.covers: an empty field list is invalid rather than a no-op

cases.name: field-name-shape
cases.covers: the vocabulary is open but the shape is checked

cases.name: type-name-shape
cases.covers: a type name starts with an upper-case letter

cases.name: url-rules-empty
cases.covers: url_rules with no recognized key says nothing

cases.name: trailing-slash-invalid
cases.covers: trailing_slash is closed: a consumer branches on it

cases.name: max-depth-not-positive
cases.covers: max_depth is 1 or more; / is depth 0

cases.name: lowercase-not-boolean
cases.covers: lowercase is true or false

cases.name: crawler-stance-invalid
cases.covers: crawler_stance is a closed vocabulary

cases.name: pages-empty
cases.covers: a plan that requires no pages omits the key

cases.name: page-not-an-object
cases.covers: every element of pages is an object; a string element is invalid
cases.expect: expected an object with path and purpose

cases.name: page-missing-purpose
cases.covers: both page keys are required within a page object

cases.name: page-path-not-absolute
cases.covers: a page path begins with a slash

cases.name: page-path-with-query
cases.covers: a path is a path; a query string is not part of it

cases.name: page-path-empty-segment
cases.covers: no empty segment, so a doubled slash is invalid

cases.name: page-path-trailing-slash
cases.covers: a path is written without a trailing slash; trailing_slash describes the built URLs

cases.name: page-path-two-placeholders
cases.covers: at most one placeholder segment per path

cases.name: page-path-malformed-placeholder
cases.covers: a placeholder names its family in lower case: <slug>, not <Slug>

cases.name: page-unknown-key
cases.covers: a page object has exactly path and purpose

cases.name: duplicate-page-path
cases.covers: paths are unique

cases.name: site-with-scheme
cases.covers: site is a bare domain; paths belong in pages

cases.name: site-with-port
cases.covers: site carries no port

cases.name: site-empty
cases.covers: an empty string is never a value; omit the key instead

cases.name: site-with-space
cases.covers: values are used as written; a validator does not trim them

cases.name: pages-exceed-max-depth
cases.covers: the one rule that spans two keys: pages may not contradict url_rules

cases.name: placeholder-counts-as-one-segment
cases.covers: a placeholder segment contributes one to the depth, not none
